title: Manager coaching velocity play notes
content:
Snapshot: working notes for manager coaching cadence, quick experiments to raise team delivery velocity without adding narrow process overhead. Mix of personal reminders, candidate talking points for 1:1s, evidence lines for calibration, and small experiments to A/B across managers.

Why this doc exists:
- I want a compact set of interventions I can try with managers during 1:1 coaching or skip-levels. Not prescriptive org-wide policy; lightweight hypotheses to test.
- Capture quick metrics to watch and the people signals that matter beyond PR throughput (e.g., unblock discovery, cross-team trust).

Top hypotheses to test (short form):
1) Weekly 15-min "focus sync" reduces context-switching waste and increases sprint predictability for small teams.
   - Signal: fewer mid-sprint scope additions, higher % of committed tickets merged by end of sprint.
   - Quick metric: percent of sprint-carryover (target -10% in 6 weeks).
2) Two-step 1:1 agenda (blockers + career micro-step) improves retention intent and reduces escalation volume.
   - Signal: higher saturation of promotable behaviors in next cycle, lower reassignments.
3) Calling out "one-decision" in meetings (owner + deadline + contingency) shortens decision time and reduces follow-ups.
   - Signal: decisions resolved within 48 hours vs 72 baseline.

Micro-experiments to run (owner, duration, measurement):
- Experiment A: Manager-run 15-min focus sync, twice/week for 4 squads. Owner: Jordan. Duration: 6 weeks. Measure: sprint-carryover %, number of mid-sprint scope changes.
- Experiment B: Add career micro-step to 1:1 agenda for 3 managers. Owner: Priya. Duration: 8 weeks. Measure: number of promotable behaviors surfaced, 1:1 satisfaction NPS (quick poll).
- Experiment C: Meeting decision template trial in product sync. Owner: me. Duration: 4 weeks. Measure: decision time median.

Notes to self: implementation tips
- Keep templates tiny: one-line copy-pasteable agenda, optional Slack reminder snippet.
- Prefer manager opt-in cohorts; treat as coaching, not policy.
- Pair with data link (lightweight query) so managers can see impact quickly — e.g., sprint carryover dashboard card.

Talking points / quick scripts for manager coaching 1:1s
- "What's one thing we can stop doing next sprint that will free up bandwidth?" (forces pruning)
- "Tell me a recent decision we spent too long on — who owned it and what blocked closure?" (tells process debt)
- "What's one skill you're nudging up for your ICs this quarter?" (connects coaching to performance)

Evidence snippets to collect during coaching
- Specific blocker + root cause + time to resolution. Keep a 1-line log per coaching session.
- A named example of scope creep (ticket ids) in last sprint.
- A micro-success: an experiment tried and outcome (even if failed).

Manager cheat-sheet (one-pager bullets to share):
- Before sprint: 15-min focus sync to align top 3 outcomes.
- During sprint: block triage cadence (who owns the unblock, due date).
- 1:1 structure: 5m wellbeing, 10m blockers, 10m progress/decisions, 5m career micro-step.
- Meeting default: owner + decision + fallback.

Potential risks / signals to stop an experiment
- Risk: experiments create extra meeting overhead and surface-level compliance.
  - Stop if manager satisfaction drops >15% or if team reports more meetings than before.
- Risk: metrics noisy / confounded by product re-orgs.
  - Check qualitative signals (anecdotes) alongside numbers.

Open questions / TODOs
- Need a small query to compute sprint-carryover per team (ask analytics for a templated card).
- Who will be the baseline control group? Decide by next week — propose two managers with stable squads.
- Draft Slack reminder snippet and 1:1 agenda template for sharing.

Quick links (to attach later):
- sample 1:1 agenda template (placeholder)
- sprint-carryover query (ask analytics)

Short-term action list (next 10 days)
- [ ] Finalize manager cohort (target 6 squads). (owner: me)
- [ ] Draft focus-sync agenda and slack reminder. (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Request sprint-carryover metric card from analytics. (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Run pilot meeting decision template in product sync (owner: me).

Reflection prompt for follow-ups (for myself):
- After 4 weeks: what pattern emerged that surprised me?
- After 8 weeks: which intervention scaled easily and which needed heavy coaching?

Freeform notes / scratch lines (raw):
- Consider pairing this with manager office hours — open slot where managers swap notes weekly. Might accelerate transfer of local hacks.
- Interview prompt: "Give me an example of a decision you wish had been faster." Useful for narratives in calibration.
- Keep a short list of wins to highlight in the next all-hands (operational successes, not heroics).

End of note for now. Will iterate after first pilot cohort results.
